programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Un dinosaure dans les égouts !
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (1/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (2/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au-delà des frontières de l'espace
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les lunes de Thalos 3
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le monde selon Wyrm
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le chasseur de primes
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'énigme des Anciens Eons
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'arène du carnage
programme.desc: Les tortues arrivent à s'introduire dans le vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Mais elles sont faites prisonnières et deviennent des gladiateurs dans l'arène Tricératon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Bataille pour la Dimension X
programme.desc: Sal et Mona tentent de s'allier avec Krang Second pour combattre les Tricératons. Krang Second les jette en prison. Les tortues sont à la recherche des autres fragments du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'océan cosmique
programme.desc: Les tortues partent à la recherche du deuxième fragment que les Outromes ont confié aux Dagones Celles-ci vivent dans un royaume sous-marin, dans l'océan cosmique de Varuna.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les tortues transdimensionnelles
programme.desc: Alors que les tortues s'apprêtent à partir chercher le dernier morceau du générateur de trou noir, elles sont happées dans un univers parallèle, celui des tortues ninja du dessin animé de 1987.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La vengeance des Tricératons
programme.desc: Les Tricératons ont suivi la trace du vaisseau Ulysse. Ils lancent un ultimatum à son équipage : soit ils leur remettent les fragments, soit ils se font anéantir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Dregg le maléfique
programme.desc: Les tortues captent un signal de détresse. C'est Mona, qui leur apprend que son commandant Sal a été capturé par Armaggon sur l'ordre de Dregg.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le feu éternel
programme.desc: Direction l'autre bout du cosmos, vers une galaxie au nom à rallonge, ZZ-Trois-Pluriel-X-Bêta, et plus particulièrement la planète Magdomar qui abrite selon les Outromes le troisième et dernier fragment du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Ultime chance pour la Terre
programme.desc: Le compte à rebours est lancé avant la mise en route du générateur de trou noir par les Tricératons pour aspirer la planète Terre. Il reste peu de temps aux tortues pour empêcher ces derniers de réduire la planète à néant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La guerre des clans
programme.desc: Retour dans un New York tranquille. Cérémonie pour April, organisée par Splinter. Elle est désormais kunoïchi. Mais le soir même, une mystérieuse sorcière lui vole son tanto du dragon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Foot contre Foot
programme.desc: Leonardo a fait alliance en cachette avec Karaï et Shinigami pour démanteler une à une les opérations de Shredder. Ils commencent par une planque des Dragons Pourpres, puis s'attaquent à l'usine chimique, un lieu névralgique de l'organisation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Infectes insectes
programme.desc: Stockman crée de nouveaux mutants pour l'aider à cambrioler les banques afin de réunir de l'argent pour Shredder. Un ancien homme d'affaires devient Scaramouche, un mutant mi-araignée mi-mouche. Il crée également une fourmi géante.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants contre-attaquent
programme.desc: Don Vizioso veut prendre le contrôle de la ville. Pour cela, il doit se débarrasser des mutants présents dans la ville de New York.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une chauve-souris dans le beffroi
programme.desc: Mikey, Leo et Raph se disputent au sujet de leur BD préférée. Pour Mikey, Bat-Boulon et Écrou Kid sont au-dessus du panier. Leo préfère l'Homme-araignée, Supérieur-Man, ou encore l'Invincible Bossu. Pour Raph, il n'y a pas photo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Super Shredder
programme.desc: Shredder absorbe du mutagène et devient Super Shredder. Il capture Karai pour attirer Splinter dans un piège et en finir avec son ennemi juré. Mais Splinter lit clair dans son jeu et le piège à son tour.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au fond du trou
programme.desc: Tandis que Donnie et Mikey partent explorer le gouffre à la recherche de Splinter, Leo, April et Karai affrontent Super Shredder. Karaï trouve son point faible : son cœur protubérant. Mais le méchant s'échappe à temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Cette force en elle
programme.desc: April a une conduite de plus en plus étrange. Elle est possédée par un ancien Eon, Za-Noran, par l'intermédiaire de son cristal. Les tortues décident de détruire la pierre pour sauver leur amie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tokka contre le reste du monde
programme.sub-title: Tokka contre le reste du monde
programme.desc: Quand Tokka décide de récupérer son petit, c'est le branle-bas de combat sur Terre. Les Forces de Protection Terriennes décident d'attaquer malgré les mises en garde de Bishop.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Tiger Claw et sa sœur Alopex ont été enlevés enfants par les Krangs. Le tigre et la renarde sont devenus ennemis. Alopex vole les lames de la vengeance dans un musée pour détruire son frère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Requiem
programme.desc: Super Shredder teste un nouveau super mutagène concocté par Stockman-mouche, qui se révèle parfait pour sa prochaine mission : exterminer tous ses ennemis sans exception, et sans empathie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La fin
programme.desc: Les tortues rendent visite à Karaï à l'hôpital. Elle leur révèle où se trouve la planque de Super Shredder. Il s'agit d'une forteresse high-tech en pleine forêt, défendue par ses footbots et autres sergents.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le rouleau du Démodragon
programme.desc: Les tortues enquêtent sur une mystérieuse secte qui se réunit dans les égoûts. Tiger Claw a décidé de ressusciter Super Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'épéiste oublié
programme.desc: Tiger Claw ordonne à Kavaxas de ramener Rahzar à la vie, ce qu'il parvient à faire. Il lui dit de reproduire ce prodige avec Shredder. Mais il lui manque un élément essentiel, le Kuro Kabuto.

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this adventure, we travel west to central South Dakota for a Deer hunt of a lifetime!! Military and Law Enforcement Veteran David Huntimer is able to join along as we spot and stalk whitetails and mule deer across the prairie and coulee landscape. Guiding us on the trip is AHO Ambassador John Pikop and Volunteer fire fighter Dustin Aske. We even get a surprise fire call on this outing!! We also highlight our next SCHEELS hometown hero, Mike Hawkins!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Four minutes. That’s all we had left before cutoff time and somehow, it all came together. After a tough morning hunt in the Illinois woods, everything changed in the final moments. We finally got a longbeard to commit, and we made it count just before time ran out. This is one of those hunts that reminds you why we do it.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Mike, Jacob and Terry are still in Tennessee and hot on more longbeards! They have one coming in but Mike decides he can't wait any longer and excuses himself with some TP. This gobbler puts on quite the show before Jacob puts the Ninja on him! Terry is running camera along with Dylan, but Terry is having some technical difficulties with his "Ghost Footage".

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Kyle and Skeet are headed to Oklahoma to hunt Rios with Mark Scroggins. An early morning setup almost works but some quick adjustments and timely calling puts a gobbler on the cow trail and coming right to the second setup! The APEX Turkey Ninja TSS .410 load crumbles another longbeard!

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Skeet, Kyle and Mark are in Texas and they slip into this creek bottom that is supposed to have a gobbler that works it regularly. It doesn't take long to get eyes on him but this longbeard Rio is trying to pull a classic hook on 'em. Let's see if they can cut him off before he gets the upper hand.

programme.title: TRP
programme.desc: In this episode of the Tom Roland Podcast, brought to you by Danco, Captain Harley Hunt provides essential boating advice on how to determine if you're dragging anchor. Harley explains the importance of marking your GPS when setting the anchor and monitoring the distance to ensure you are stationary. He emphasizes the significance of re-anchoring if dragging occurs and shares the Coast Guard's recommended scope ratio for anchoring. Additionally, Harley discusses the benefits of using more chain to help the anchor dig in better. Tune in for valuable tips whether you're an experienced or beginner boater. - Watch now to enhance your skills and improve your fishing game! programme.title: The WoodHaven Way

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Year's Eve at Leopard's Den. Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby is causing tension between her and Danny. Liv is furious that Fatani hasn't told his mother about their relationship.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Danny is having second thoughts about the wisdom of uprooting his new family and ploughing all their money into a business venture that they know next to nothing about.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Work To Do
programme.desc: A successful giraffe capture means everyone is in high spirits, until the arrival of Evan and Olivia's real father, Simon, throws the family into turmoil.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Meerly Evan
programme.desc: Evan lets the mischievous meerkats loose in Rosie's room to cause havoc. Rosie is devastated when they destroy an irreplaceable photograph of her mother and rages at Evan. She decides once and for all to go back to Bristol.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Evan Meets Elli
programme.desc: Rogue young male elephants are rampaging through Leopard's Den and destroying everything the family have built, so Danny introduces a matriarch elephant in the hope that she will calm them down.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Dawn Feeling
programme.desc: At a typically rowdy family breakfast, Rosie is excitedly looking forward to the arrival of her friend Izzy, whilst Danny is concerned about the rumour of ivory poachers in the area. Unnoticed, Miranda the lion cub pads off into the bush.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: The Trevanions have been living at Leopard's Den for over a year. The wildlife is roaming freely and the family are settled into African way of life. Business however is not good. With an abundance of game lodges competition is fierce.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: It's the grand reopening of Mara and a British wildlife charity is using the event to release a vulture back into the wild. Fatani, the new, young and ambitious manager of Mara has hired Danny as the vet to oversee the release.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den is looking after a sick and orphaned baby elephant called Togo. However, despite Evan and Du Plessis' constant vigil, Togo is dying from a broken heart. Evan is distraught and Du Plessis promises they will look after her together.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Sarah's absence couldn't have come at a worse time for Leopard's Den. Nature Conservation is carrying out their annual inspection and everything has to be tip top. Danny's determined they pass with flying colours and everyone is roped in to help.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Everyone's excited at the prospect of Leopard's Den's new arrival. Bash, Danny's old tutor and Rosie's Godfather, is coming from England to help Danny grow his veterinary practice.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: The Trevanions are delighted when Fatani asks Danny to take an aggressive hippo off his hands. As they prepare for its arrival Sarah gets a bit of a shock when her mother Caroline beats the hippo to the post.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Business is looking up at Leopard's Den but Sarah is feeling agitated. Caroline thinks it because Simon, her ex husband and Evan and Olivia's Dad, is arriving from England to get married. But Sarah has other things on her mind.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny is undertaking a drugs trial at Leopard's Den. But de-worming wildebeest isn't Caroline's idea of fun. She hates animals and finds the whole business mind-numbingly boring.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Paul and Perry kick off an adventurous journey down the Ivanhoe River, heading toward a lake that’s known to deliver steady walleye action. But this time, the fish had other plans. With walleye proving tough to track down, the duo turns to the river’s reliable residents—Northern Pike—to keep the rods bending and the spirits high. Surrounded by stunning scenery, flowing rapids, and beautiful waterfalls, this river run becomes more than just a fishing trip—it’s a reminder that the North’s wild beauty always makes the day worthwhile, no matter what’s biting.

programme.title: FishON! | Remote Escapes: Pike Frenzy and Hidden Lake Explorations
programme.desc: In the thrilling Season 7 finale, Paul & Perry and the team venture deep into Northern Ontario, using a Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake with high hopes for walleye. However, the day takes a surprising turn as Northern Pike steal the show with their spirited action. The adventure doesn’t end there—a bonus portage into another lake offers a chance to explore uncharted waters. It’s a fitting conclusion to a season filled with the unexpected and unforgettable.
